map.基于基础-餐时(Basal-Bolus)方案，根据血糖监测数据计算胰岛素剂量调整: Based on a basal-bolus regimen, calculate insulin dose adjustment advice from blood glucose monitoring data
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：min(100, max(0, (basalDose: Core formulas (by input): min(100, max(0, (basalDose ÷ (tdi × 0.8)) × 100)); max(0, basalDose + basalAdjust); bolusTotal × 0.30
map.📖 查看「胰岛素用量(基础+餐时)调整器 使用指南」: 📖 See the "Insulin Dose (Basal + Bolus) Adjuster User Guide"
map.每日胰岛素总量估算方式: Method for estimating total daily insulin
map.基础胰岛素模拟生理性基础分泌，抑制肝糖输出；餐时胰岛素模拟餐时分泌，控制餐后血糖: Basal insulin mimics physiological basal secretion and suppresses hepatic glucose output; bolus insulin mimics meal-time secretion and controls post-meal glucose.
map.基础胰岛素调整规则（基于空腹血糖）: Basal insulin adjustment rules (based on fasting glucose)
map.餐时胰岛素调整（基于餐后2h血糖）: Bolus insulin adjustment (based on 2h post-meal glucose)
map.胰岛素敏感系数(ISF)与碳水系数(ICR): Insulin sensitivity factor (ISF) and carbohydrate ratio (ICR)
map.单位：g/U（每单位胰岛素覆盖的碳水克数）: Unit: g/U (grams of carbohydrate covered by each unit of insulin)
map.• T2DM：0.2-0.4 U/kg/d 起始，或 10U/d 起始逐步加量: • T2DM: start at 0.2-0.4 U/kg/d, or 10U/d titrated upwards
map.• 基础:餐时 = 50:50（多数患者），瘦型T1DM可40:60: • Basal:bolus = 50:50 for most patients; lean type 1 diabetes can use 40:60
map.• 调整后观察 2-3 天再评估: • Observe 2-3 days after adjusting before reassessing
map.• 优先调整基础胰岛素控制空腹血糖: • Adjust basal insulin first to control fasting glucose
map.• 餐后高血糖优先调整对应餐的餐时胰岛素: • For high post-meal glucose, adjust the bolus insulin of the matching meal
map.• 肾功能不全者胰岛素需求减少，需减量: • Insulin needs fall in renal impairment, so the dose must be reduced
map.• 感染、应激状态下胰岛素需求增加: • Insulin needs rise during infection or stress
map.• 运动前后酌情减少餐时剂量: • Consider reducing the bolus dose around exercise
map.• 警惕黎明现象与 Somogyi 效应的区别: • Watch out for the difference between the dawn phenomenon and the Somogyi effect
map.本工具仅供教育参考，胰岛素剂量调整必须由专业内分泌医师根据患者具体情况决定。请勿: This tool is for education only; insulin dose changes must be decided by a specialist endocrinologist based on the individual patient. Never adjust your insulin dose on your own, as that risks severe hypoglycaemia or ketoacidosis.
map.📚 深度解析：胰岛素用量(基础+餐时)调整器: 📚 In-depth analysis: Insulin Dose (Basal + Bolus) Adjuster
map.餐后血糖明显偏高时，用校正系数估算追加 correction dose。: Estimating a correction dose with the correction factor when post-meal glucose is clearly high.
map.不同碳水摄入量下，用碳水系数估算餐时胰岛素量。: Estimating the bolus insulin dose with the carbohydrate ratio for different carbohydrate intakes.
map.运动前后血糖波动的剂量调整参考，降低运动相关低血糖风险。: Dose adjustment reference around exercise to reduce exercise-related hypoglycaemia risk.
map.当前血糖 14.0 mmol/L，目标 7.0，采用 1800 法则且每日总量: Current glucose 14.0 mmol/L, target 7.0, using the 1800 rule with a daily total of 36 U gives ISF=(1800/36)=50 mmol/L/U: correction dose=(14-7)/50=0.14 U, that is about 1.4 U. Note: correction doses need a safety cap and should take any recent hypoglycaemia into account.
map.1800、1700、2200 法则怎么选？: How do I choose between the 1800, 1700 and 2200 rules?
map.分别适用于日总量约 1800/U 的近似场景：1700 用于年轻/胰岛素敏感者，: They suit approximate situations around a daily total of about 1800 U: 1700 for younger or insulin-sensitive people, 1800 as the routine choice, and 2200 for high insulin needs or clear resistance. All are empirical estimates.
map.这个工具能替代医生调方吗？: Can this tool replace the doctor's titration?
map.不能。仅用于理解剂量构成与微调参考，孕期、疾病、肾功能变化及频繁低血糖时应由内分: No. It only helps you understand the dose composition and fine adjustments; in pregnancy, illness, changing kidney function or frequent hypoglycaemia the regimen should be adjusted by endocrinology.
